values.note: CampLife sells 52 sites (numbered 1-53, no 23): 51 RV sites and one non-electric tent site (34). Sampled site records give lengths of 40-100 ft. Generators allowed.

sites.source: https://www.camplife.com/1028/reservation/step1 (siteMap: 51 'RV Site' + 1 'Tent'; site records maxLength 40/50/100; site 34 'NOT AN ELECTRICAL SITE, WE ALLOW GENERATORS'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Tap water in the park but not at the sites; a sewer dump in the park, not at the sites.

facilities.source: https://www.camplife.com/1028/reservation/step1 (site records: 'Electric site, sewer dump within the park but not accessible at the sites, tap water available but not at each site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Booked online through CampLife (linked from Moffat County's home page); CampLife adds its own $3.50 per stay. Sites were bookable for October 2026 and January 2027; June 2027 was 'not accepting reservations at this time'.

booking.source: https://www.camplife.com/1028/reservation/step1 (availability: 51-52 sites open 2026-10-17/20 and 2027-01-26/30; 2027-06-08/12 'The park is not accepting reservations at this time. Please choose different dates.'; 2-night estimate 53.50 vs 1-night 28.50) + https://moffatcounty.colorado.gov/ ('Maybell Park Camping Reservations'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $25 a night for the RV and tent sites quoted; site 53 $35. CampLife's own $3.50 per-stay charge is extra; no tax shown.

fees.source: https://www.camplife.com/1028/reservation/step1 (invoice estimates 2026-10-17, 2026-10-20, 2027-01-26, 2027-01-30: sites 1, 26, 27 and tent 34 at 28.50 for one night, site 1 at 53.50 for two; site 53 at 38.50 / 73.50), read 2026-10-28

note: Moffat County's park campground in Maybell (pop. ~75) on US-40, a stop for the Yampa and Green rivers, Sand Wash Basin, Browns Park and Dinosaur National Monument; busy during hunting season and the May horse drive (Maybell Heritage Days). --Claude
summary: CampLife (the county's booking link): confirmed county-run, online booking, electric sites; fees 38 (camper-reported) -> 25-35 from the operator's booking engine; count 30 -> 52; added water/dump in the park (not at sites), booking platform. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE line removed (an operator booking channel now prices it); note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Operator: Moffat County. Its home page links 'Maybell Park Camping Reservations' to camplife.com/1028, CampLife's contact is maybellpark@moffatcounty.net, and the Maybell Park Board was folded into the county's Maybell Community Board (9/21/17). Ownership local is right; public-campground ladder, no private price gate.
Website: give the booking page https://www.camplife.com/1028/reservation/step1 (or keep the CampLife listing); the county has no dedicated park page beyond that home-page link.

Wrong phone: 970-824-2335 is the Moffat County Tourism Association office (Director Tom Kleinschnitz, '824-2335 office' on the county's board page), not the park. CampLife lists no phone for the park; its published contact is maybellpark@moffatcounty.net. No park phone found.

Hookups: stored electric 30 (from a Campendium/Dyrt review, 'outer ring') is not confirmed or contradicted: CampLife's only amenity is '1-50amp' on every site type and the sampled RV sites say 'Electric site'; site 34 is non-electric. Left unchanged.
Facilities: stored flush toilets and showers ($3) come from reviews; CampLife does not mention them. Left unchanged.

Site count 52 is what CampLife sells; reviews said ~30 gravel sites, so some of the 52 may be overflow/field sites. Site lengths of 100 ft (with a 48-ft minimum) on sites 26/27 look like pull-through pads, but only five site records were read, so no max_rig_ft.
Season: no statement found. Reservations were open for October 2026 and January 2027 (suggesting year-round), but that is booking availability, not a stated season; season left unset.
Pin 40.5179,-108.0865 is ~35 m from CampLife's coordinate (40.5176,-108.08665). OK.
